classification.difficultyReason: Graphs combine horizontal and vertical scaling of standard inverse trigonometric functions.

answer.worked: Compress $y=\sin^{-1}x$ horizontally by factor $\frac13$ and stretch vertically by factor $2$. The increasing curve joins $(-\frac13,-\pi)$ to $(\frac13,\pi)$ through $(0,0)$.
